chest.definition: The front of the trunk from the neck to the abdomen.

ribcage.definition: The curved framework of ribs and related bones that surrounds and protects the heart and lungs.
ribcage.exampleUsage: The ribcage expands slightly during breathing.

abdomen.definition: The region of the body of a vertebrate between the thorax and the pelvis.

belly.definition: The region of the body of a vertebrate between the thorax and the pelvis.

navel.definition: A scar where the umbilical cord was attached.

waist.definition: The narrowing of the body between the ribs and hips.

sternum.definition: The flat bone that articulates with the clavicles and the first seven pairs of ribs.

breast.definition: The front of the trunk from the neck to the abdomen.

collarbone.definition: Bone linking the scapula and sternum.

adam-s-apple.definition: The visible front projection of the larynx formed mainly by thyroid cartilage, often more prominent after male puberty.
adam-s-apple.exampleUsage: The anatomy diagram labels the Adam's apple at the front of the neck.

shoulder.definition: The part of the body between the neck and the upper arm.

armpit.definition: The hollow under the arm where it is joined to the shoulder.

upper-arm.definition: The part of the arm between the shoulder and the elbow.
upper-arm.exampleUsage: The upper arm contains the humerus bone.

bicep.definition: People often say bicep for an upper-arm muscle or for both muscles together. Biceps brachii is the formal anatomy name.

tricep.definition: The large muscle at the back of the upper arm that helps straighten the elbow.

elbow.definition: Hinge joint between the forearm and upper arm and the corresponding joint in the forelimb of a quadruped.

forearm.definition: The part of the superior limb between the elbow and the wrist.

wrist.definition: A joint between the distal end of the radius and the proximal row of carpal bones.

arm.definition: The body part from the shoulder to the hand.

deltoid.definition: A large triangular muscle covering the shoulder joint and serving to abduct and flex and extend and rotate the arm.

upper-back.definition: The upper part of the back, around the shoulder blades and upper spine.
upper-back.exampleUsage: The diagram labels the upper back.

mid-back.definition: The middle region of the back, roughly around the lower part of the ribcage.
mid-back.exampleUsage: The illustration marks the mid-back area.

lower-back.definition: The lower region of the back around the lumbar spine.
lower-back.exampleUsage: The lumbar vertebrae are in the lower back.

spine.definition: The series of vertebrae forming the axis of the skeleton and protecting the spinal cord.

shoulder-blade.definition: Either of the two broad, triangular bones that lie behind the shoulders and help connect the arms to the body.

rib.definition: Any of the 12 pairs of curved arches of bone extending from the spine to or toward the sternum in humans (and similar bones in most vertebrates).

vertebra.definition: One of the bony segments of the spinal column.

tailbone.definition: The small bone at the bottom of the spine, medically called the coccyx.
tailbone.exampleUsage: The tailbone is located at the base of the spine.

pelvis.definition: The structure of the vertebrate skeleton supporting the lower limbs in humans and the hind limbs or corresponding parts in other vertebrates.

hip.definition: Either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

pectoral.definition: Of or relating to the chest or thorax.

abdominal.definition: Of or relating to or near the abdomen.

oblique.definition: Slanting or inclined in direction or course or position — neither parallel nor perpendicular nor right-angled.

trapezius.definition: Either of two flat triangular muscles of the shoulder and upper back that are involved in moving the shoulders and arms.

latissimus.definition: The latissimus dorsi, a broad muscle on each side of the middle and lower back that helps move the upper arm.
latissimus.exampleUsage: The latissimus helps pull the upper arm backward.

rotator-cuff.definition: A group of shoulder muscles and tendons supports the joint and allows the arm to move.

core.definition: To remove the core or center from.

flexor.definition: A skeletal muscle whose contraction bends a joint.

extensor.definition: A skeletal muscle whose contraction extends or stretches a body part.

tendon.definition: A cord or band of inelastic tissue connecting a muscle with its bony attachment.

skin.definition: A natural protective body covering and site of the sense of touch.

pore.definition: Any small opening in the skin or outer surface of an animal.
pore.exampleUsage: The pore was identified during the lesson.

freckle.definition: A small brownish spot (of the pigment melanin) on the skin.

mole.definition: A small congenital pigmented spot on the skin.

birthmark.definition: A blemish on the skin that is formed before birth.

scar.definition: A mark left on the skin after a wound has healed.

wrinkle.definition: To become wrinkled or crumpled or creased.

goosebumps.definition: Reflex erection of hairs of the skin in response to cold or emotional stress or skin irritation.

tan.definition: A browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun.

sunburn.definition: Redness of the skin caused by exposure to the rays of the sun.
